notes: City of Grand Prairie, TX: the whole city within city limits, across Dallas, Tarrant and Ellis Counties. Built by data/jurisidictions/run_grandprairie.py, which feeds three county sources into the shared tx_pipeline. 54,805 parcels, $5.01B land (Dallas $3.14B, Tarrant $1.70B, Ellis $171M). All values 2026.

Dallas County (most of the city): Dallas Central Appraisal District's 2026 certified data files (current certified values with supplements, files of 2026-11-09), joined on GIS_PARCEL_ID to DCAD's parcel polygons (2026-11); both downloaded by hand from dallascad.org (dcad_county.py). DCAD's own codes are mapped to statewide classes with DCAD's crosswalk (C12/C13 vacant commercial/industrial lots -> vacant commercial). Check: DCAD's taxable land on City of Grand Prairie accounts is $3.16B vs $3.14B kept here (public owners and non-land records dropped).

Tarrant County: the Fort Worth-hosted TAD layer filled from TAD's 2026 export, as for Arlington and Fort Worth (TAD city code 38). Ellis County: Ellis Appraisal District's 2026 certified export (2026-07-30) joined on prop_id to the district's parcel shapefile (entity 338). The 0.16 km2 Johnson County sliver has no parcels in these sources.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4830464; the counties' Grand Prairie codes agree on all but 45 / 80 accounts.

Exempt land dropped: DCAD's totally exempt accounts, TAD's $0 city-taxable signal, Ellis's EX flags, plus class X and named public owners (1,300 records). 1,160 leased-space mobile homes (personal property) and 69 utility records are left off.

Mobile-home parks and co-ops: every space or share is a DCAD account carrying an interest in the park's land (Sherwood Village: 427 accounts; Avion Village co-op: 300 shares of 1/300), summed onto the park polygon (239 polygons, 1,722 records). Condos: 18 units in 5 developments merged onto their land; 344 leftover nominal common areas (342 ac) dropped like exempt land.

Land size: appraiser acreage when within 25% of the polygon; 103 parcels drawn as fragments of their roll area use the appraiser's area; 32 sub-500 sqft remnants hidden, plus 1 vacant 665 sqft strip DCAD prices at a full lot's flat $55,000 (Greenwood No 2, lot 9R.1, $83/sqft; the matching strip on the other side is $100).

Singularity sweep: 54 of 54,805 parcels, all genuine appraiser values: e.g. Westchester lots at $12/sqft next to Lakeside 1 & 2, an old paper subdivision of 1,100 sqft lots DCAD values at a flat $500 each.
Under 100k parcels: browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles bake.
Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only): 140 lots, 168.2 acres, $25.7M est. land value. apply_parking_category.py tagged 13 parcels 'Parking Lot'.

Links: Dallas County parcels open DCAD's account page for their division (dallascad.org/AcctDetailRes.aspx?ID=<account> for residential, AcctDetailCom.aspx for commercial), Tarrant parcels TAD's (tad.org/property?account=<account>), Ellis parcels Ellis CAD's property page pinned to 2026 (elliscad.com/property-detail/<prop_id>/2026). DCAD and Ellis patterns confirmed by the user.
